info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Extend Authorization API
info.description: The Extend Authorization API enables clients to extend existing authorizations with additional time or resources, ensuring ongoing access to necessary services. This endpoint is primarily used by service providers and systems managing authorization processes to seamlessly update the authorization duration or capabilities. By providing a straightforward method to modify authorizations, the API helps enhance user experience and maintain service continuity. This functionality is especially beneficial for applications that require dynamic authorization adjustments based on user or system requirements.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to extend an existing authorization identified by the specified resource ID. A successful request will update the expiration or other applicable details of the authorization, allowing continued access to protected resources.

requestBody.description: This request allows for the extension of an existing authorization identified by RES-100045. The payload must include all necessary information required to process the extension, including any relevant parameters as specified in the schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the authorization has been extended.
